title: Maison
description: Monochrome luxury salon: warm white, black bands, light Cormorant display type and a brass accent.

tokens.HERO_HEADLINE: Precision cutting and colour, without the theatre
tokens.HERO_LEDE: One client at a time, in a quiet room, for as long as the work needs.
tokens.ABOUT_HEADING: A private atelier with one chair
tokens.ABOUT_TEXT: Maison Vale opened in 2019 with one idea: remove everything that does not improve the haircut. No double bookings, no background noise, and no product you did not ask about.
tokens.QUOTE: A good cut is the one you forget about for three months.
tokens.FOOTER_BLURB: A private hair atelier. One chair, one client, by appointment.
